semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in the production of silicon carbide substrates, which are critical materials for various semiconductor applications.
summary: Guangzhou Summit Crystal Semiconductor Co., Ltd. is a key player in the semiconductor materials sector, focusing on the R&D, production, and sales of silicon carbide single crystal materials. The company operates three major production bases and offers a range of silicon carbide substrates in various sizes to meet market demands.
capabilities: Production of 6-inch, 8-inch, and 12-inch silicon carbide substrates
Collaboration with academic institutions for R&D

regional_presence.China: The company is headquartered in Nansha, Guangzhou, and has production facilities in Zhongshan and Jinan.
